text: I'm really scared please someone get back to me. My son is 9, he's had a temperature since last night, 38.1 just now. He was sick once about an hour ago but he's kept his drinks down since. His breathing is really fast and I can see the skin pulling in under his ribs every time he breathes in, it's sucking right in, it's never done that before. His colour looks normal, his lips and face are their usual colour, and he hasn't had any fit or shaking or anything like that. I just don't like how hard he's working to breathe.
